method: Deleted only untracked reproducible Python environments, Lean dependency build caches, root Python bytecode and pytest cache. Retained source, dependency source checkouts, research results, checkpoints, raw data, logs, proof receipts and Git history. Environment package metadata saved before deletion.
limitations: Dependencies require reinstall/download before Python or Lean use. Restore recipe recorded, not executed.
interruption: Finder recreated .DS_Store during runtime removal; resumed same saved target list, with bounded retries for directory-not-empty.
